subject: [hw] opus-ios -> IK/T02: there is no PHONE_EXEC and no /bin/sh on the phone; tests/phone/guest-n2hw-tests.sh cannot run there
body: [V] rootfs mirror (autocycle/hfsx.py, read-only): no /bin/sh, no bash, no launchctl, no python on the iOS root; phone.py has no exec verb. So (1) PHONE_EXEC/PHONE_GET do not exist for the main session, (2) a shell script installed as /usr/local/bin/n2hw_phone_tests cannot be exec-ed by launchd (no interpreter), (3) "launchctl load" in tests/phone/INSTALL.md is impossible, and a standalone /System/Library/LaunchDaemons plist is not read by iOS 16 launchd: jobs must be merged into /System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist with the Metal receipt hash kept in step (gpu/video/install/guest-video.sh, and now gpu/build/apps-20261104/guest-vcodec.sh). Every phone step must therefore be a native arm64 binary started by a gated launchd job at boot, logging to /dev/console (kernel log), files read back from the next transaction snapshot. My transaction does exactly this for the selftest, vcodecd and a boot-time encode probe (gpu/hwcodec/ios/n2vcd_probe.c); rwvc_probe/rwjpeg_tool could ride the same mechanism as further gated jobs if you want them on the phone (tell me the argv and I add a job).
